name: Ring of Shooting Stars

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Ball Lightning
powers.text: 2 charges: a crackling sphere of lightning bursts on a point within 120 ft (Dex DC 15, 4d12 Lightning, half on a success).

powers.name: Shooting Stars
powers.text: 1 to 3 charges: a glowing mote per charge streaks to a point within 60 ft; creatures there make a Dex save (DC 15) or take 4d4 Fire per mote (half on a success).

summary: 6 charges: Faerie Fire, ball lightning and shooting stars; Dancing Lights and Light at will in the dark.
text: Dancing Lights and Light are castable from this ring at will while you wear it in Dim Light or darkness. It also holds 6 charges, regaining 1d6 each dawn, which power three other effects. Faerie Fire (1 charge): cast the spell, save DC 15. Ball Lightning (2 charges): a sphere of lightning appears at a point you choose within 120 feet, and creatures within 5 feet of the sphere each make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 15) and take 4d12 Lightning damage on a failure, or half that on a success. Shooting Stars (1 to 3 charges): one mote of light per charge streaks out to a spot up to 60 feet away, and creatures inside a 15-foot cube centred there each make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 15); on a failure a creature takes 4d4 Fire damage per mote, or half that on a success.
